This '''chocolate cheesecake''' is rich in both chocolate and cheese. It is noticeably less sweet than many other American desserts, and somewhat more complicated.

==Ingredients==
===Crust===
*5 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted 
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] chocolate wafer/[[Cookbook:Cookie|cookie]]/[[Cookbook:Graham Cracker|graham cracker]] crumbs
===Filling===
*3 packages (24 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] / 705 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]], at room temperature
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] packed [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
*5 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (250 g) [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]s
*4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] (215 g / 4 squares) [[Cookbook:Chocolate|semisweet chocolate]], melted
===Topping===
*6 ounces (150 g / 6 squares) semisweet chocolate, melted
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Sour Cream|sour cream]]

== Helpful equipment ==
*[[Cookbook:Mixer|Electric mixer]]
*[[Cookbook:Springform Pan|Springform pan]]

==Procedure==
#Place rack in center of the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]]. Preheat oven to 150 °C (300 °F).
#If starting with whole cookies, crackers, or wafers, place them in a sturdy plastic bag a few at a time and crush using a [[Cookbook:Rolling Pin|rolling pin]], or grind using a [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]].
#Mix together chocolate crumbs and melted butter.
#Press crumb mixture into bottom and sides of 9-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] [[Cookbook:Springform Pan|springform pan]]. 
#In a large bowl, [[Cookbook:Beating|beat]] together sugar and eggs at medium speed, slowly adding cream cheese, until smooth and fluffy. 
#Spoon half of cream cheese mixture into crust.
#Melt 4 ounces of chocolate using a [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]] or, with care, a [[Cookbook:Microwave Oven|microwave]].  Stir into remaining cream cheese mixture until well blended. 
#Drizzle chocolate cream cheese mixture over batter in crust. Draw a spoon or other implement through the batter a few times to make swirls. Spread evenly.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] cheesecake for 50 minutes. After the first 30 minutes has gone by, place [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]] on top to prevent cracking and scorching.  
#Cool completely.
#Cover with [[Cookbook:Plastic Wrap|plastic wrap]], and chill for about 2 hours or up to several days.
#Transfer cheesecake to a serving plate.
#Uncover cheesecake; carefully remove side of pan.
=== Topping ===
#Melt remaining chocolate.
#Mix with sour cream.
#Spread over cake, and chill to set.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*Brown sugar is not absolutely necessary (you can substitute [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated]]), but it provides better flavor.
*If no electric mixer is available, the cream cheese can be mixed with egg yolks one-at-a-time before the whites are added. Unless you find separating eggs extremely difficult, this will be worthwhile for the effort saved in mixing.
*Without a springform pan, a cake this stiff will require that at least the first piece be broken up in the process of serving.  Fortunately, it's often easy to find someone who [[Cookbook:Aesthetics|doesn't care]].
*Without aluminum foil, the top of the cake will crack and brown somewhat, but the topping covers it effectively, making it practically unnoticeable.
